description: Zyphra ZONOS3-Mini: a GDN/attention latent-MoE TTS backbone with Full AttnRes over 10 delayed 4096-entry codebooks and a 44.1 kHz MR-iSTFT decoder, with speaker-embedding and raw-reference cloning.

request.name: language
request.description: Text-normalization grammar: en_us, en_gb, fr_fr, de, es, it, pt_br, ja, cmn or ko (aliases en, fr, pt, zh). The model itself takes no language input.

request.name: text_normalization
request.description: Rewrite numbers, symbols and abbreviations into spoken form with zyphra-textnorm. Builds without AUDIOCPP_ZONOS3_TEXTNORM only collapse line breaks.

request.name: seed
request.description: Sampler seed; random when omitted. Long-form chunk i uses seed + i.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Generated 15 Hz rows per text chunk, including the 11-row end-of-speech drain.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Sampling temperature; 0 decodes greedily.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Top-k candidates per codebook (ties at the threshold are kept).

request.name: top_p
request.description: Nucleus probability per codebook.

request.name: min_p
request.description: Drops candidates below min_p times the most likely one.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Penalty on codes seen in the repetition window.

request.name: repetition_window
request.description: Frames of per-codebook history the repetition penalty looks at.

request.name: repetition_codebooks
request.description: Leading codebooks the repetition penalty applies to; -1 applies it to all ten.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Speaker classifier-free guidance; 1 disables it. Needs a speaker source.

request.name: speaker_mode
request.description: How --voice-ref audio conditions the prompt: embedding (MECT-B2 speaker embedding) or reference (ZAC reference codes; needs zac-encoder.gguf and ssl-teacher.gguf).

request.name: speaker_embedding_file
request.description: float32 .npy speaker embedding with shape [192] or [1,192], as written by encode_reference_only.

request.name: reference_codes_file
request.description: Integer or float .npy reference codes with shape [T,10], values 0..4095; the first 900 frames are used.

request.name: encode_reference_only
request.description: Return the --voice-ref speaker embedding (or reference codes with speaker_mode=reference) as an .npy artifact without generating speech.

request.name: loudness
request.description: Target loudness in LUFS, mapped to a condition bucket.

request.name: fmax
request.description: Target bandwidth in Hz, mapped to a condition bucket.

request.name: speaking_rate_bps
request.description: Target speaking rate in UTF-8 bytes per second, mapped to a condition bucket.

request.name: condition_buckets
request.description: Explicit bucket ids 'loudness,fmax,speaking_rate'; an id equal to the table's bucket count means unknown. Each entry overrides the matching value option.

request.name: silence_prefill_frames
request.description: Silence frames primed into the audio stream before generation.

request.name: headroom_db
request.description: Output attenuation in dB; defaults to the decoder's headroom_db (3).

request.name: soft_limit
request.description: Apply the -1 dBFS tanh soft limiter after the gain.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum Unicode code points per long-form text chunk.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Text chunking policy for long-form input.

session.name: encoder_backend
session.description: Backend for the speaker encoder, ZAC encoder and SSL teacher: cpu, or the session backend (same).

session.name: keep_reference_encoder
session.description: Keep the raw-reference encoder (ZAC encoder + w2v-BERT teacher, about 3.4 GiB peak RSS while encoding) loaded between requests instead of releasing it after each encode.

session.name: voice_cache_slots
session.description: LRU slots for computed speaker embeddings and reference codes per reference clip; 0 disables caching.

session.name: stream_chunk_frames
session.description: Maximum 15 Hz frames per streamed decoder chunk.

session.name: disk_experts
session.description: Keep the routed expert banks in the GGUF/host memory and stage the selected experts through a bounded per-layer cache on the compute backend.

session.name: pin_experts
session.description: With disk_experts, hold the full expert banks in pinned host memory for direct uploads.

session.name: expert_cache_size
session.description: Expert slots per MoE layer with disk_experts; at least twice the routed top-k.

session.name: disk_expert_read_threads
session.description: Host workers copying selected experts with disk_experts and without pin_experts.

packages.description: Q4_0-expert / Q8_0-mixer backbone, keep2 MR-iSTFT decoder, MECT-B2 speaker encoder (1.2 GB).
Adds the ZAC encoder and w2v-BERT teacher for speaker_mode=reference (+5.6 GB).
